modules.module_title: Make organization ready for onboarding of Persons with Disability

pcs.pc_description: conduct need assessment to identify existing opportunity/ies and Job roles for Persons with Disability as per operational plan
identify potential barriers during recruitment and placement of a Person with Disability
ensure accessibility of workplace infrastructure like chairs, desks, boards, projectors, computers, meeting area, conference room, and stay arrangements etc. for the use of Persons with Disability
ensure relevant modifications required at the workplace
ensure safety parameters (eg alarms) to meet the specific requirement of the Persons with Disability
identify workplace support to assist the Persons with a Disability (assistive and supportive aids)
establish contact with other agencies working for Persons with Disability
plan orientation sessions for the senior officials and staff members to develop inclusive culture
provide information about reasonable accommodations to employers as per specific requirements of disability
recommend the Application, Selection & Recruitment process including good practices in interviewing techniques
form an advisory group of individuals/ organizations for different disabilities
encourage the use of people first language

pcs.pc_description: Organize orientation/ induction/ training sessions for the employees with disability
assist the employee for any concerns related to work (routine activities like transportation or lodging/office tasks etc.)
provide on-site support to the employees with disability in order to help them adjust to the workplace and the routine of getting to and from work
facilitate interdepartmental communication/dialogues of employee with disability with other colleagues

plan activities to enhance relationship and create positive environment at the workplace for employees with disability
encourage/motivate employees with disability to be more productive at the workplace
provide information about career progression and further growth to persons with disability in the organization
